posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
That was a cool glimpse into the progress happening on Sentinels of Freedom! I can't wait to hear the character voices in-game. :)

In case anybody is interested in more accounts about Teddy Roosevelt's speech following an assassination attempt, here is a good account from Smithsonian. I've seen transcripts of the speech on the internet in various places...they are pretty amazing. He keeps telling people trying to drag him off state that no, no, he's just fine, see, the bullet barely touched him, let him show you... 

So in real-life physics, nothing can exceed the speed of light. One of the physical manifestations of that fact is that it takes infinite energy to push an object with mass up to the speed of light. At low speed, putting 1 unit of energy into an object increases its speed by 1 unit - but as speed builds up, it takes more than 1 unit of energy to add just 1 unit of speed. This provides an easy explanation to why Tachyon has no fundamental speed limit, but going too fast would kill her - she'd burn herself up for energy before getting near the speed of light.

Why could I not find this thread by searching “Editor’s Note 29”?

Francis King would like to be Frank with us…Joe is now determined to start his own Freedom Five, with blackjack and snookers!

Unity being a blind spot for the FF makes me think of Miss Information. “You’re helping everyone else, why are you so mean to me?” I think an alternate universe Unity might be so traumatized, immature, And poorly handled that she becomes MI instead of Amina.

Xtremeverse Teddy Roosevelt got the much bigger statue next to Mt. Rushmore, which in our world is an unfinished Crazy Horse. (That said, Teddy probably isn’t that impressive to Extreme people, since every other president is brought up to his level.)
